messages.text: I'm looking for a large globe - with a stable base

The Eureka 16" Blue Ocean Raised Relief Globe you were just looking at has a black metal gyromatic base, which is built to hold steady while you spin it freely. If you want something even bigger as a true floor centerpiece, the Replogle Westminster 16" Antique Raised Relief Floor Globe stands on a solid hardwood floor stand for extra stability and presence in a room. Are you thinking of this for a desk or a spot on the floor?

The Eureka 16" Blue Ocean Raised Relief Globe is a great fit then — at 16 inches it's larger than the usual 12" desktop globes, and its black metal gyromatic base is designed to keep it steady on a desk while still swiveling smoothly. It's $234.75 CAD. You'll find it under that name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
and the discount for asking your opinion?

I don't have any discount code to offer for that, sorry! If you'd like, I can point you to [the FAQ](https://replogleglobes.ca/pages/faq) or you can reach (email hidden) if you think you're missing a promotion. Want me to help you get the Eureka 16" into your cart?
